title: Riotously interfering with railway, vehicle, etc.
text: 83. All persons are guilty of an offence who being riotously assembled unlawfully and with force, prevent, hinder or obstruct the loading or unloading of any railway, vehicle or vessel, or the starting or transit of any railway or vehicle, or the sailing or navigating of any vessel, or unlawfully and with force board railway, vehicle or vessel with intent so to do.
